title: Stop confusing noise with loyalty. 🚫 There is a massive difference between an audience that watches your battle and an army that fights beside you.
paragraphs: Stop confusing noise with loyalty. 🚫 There is a massive difference between an audience that watches your battle and an army that fights beside you.

The hardest truth to swallow in spiritual warfare is that sometimes the enemy isn't outside the gate; they are standing right next to you, shouting "Amen" the loudest. They aren't praying for your victory; they are preying on your vulnerability to boost their own self-righteousness.
Discernment isn't cynicism. It's survival. Know your circle.

📖 The Word: “Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name...?’ Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Away from Me, you evildoers!’” — Matthew 7:22-23 (NIV)
